title: Microbiota and Chemical Associations in Gut Environment
summary: This cluster explores the relationships between gut microbiota and various chemicals in the gut environment. The CON-DLY group shows significant differences compared to the SC-DLY group. Lactobacillus plantarum produces indole-3-lactic acid, which is associated with CD8 + T cell immunity and colorectal tumorigenesis. Skatole has a higher concentration in the CON-DLY group and is associated with indole. The CON-DLY group has a higher abundance of Proteobacteria. Aryl hydrocarbon receptor is involved in gut microbiota regulation, and indole is associated with indoxyl. Indoxyl sulfate is associated with indoxyl.
